description: A global near real-time dataset of Microwave Integrated Drought Index from the Fengyun-3 satellites is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Anzhi Zhang et al. Droughts have become more frequent and intense with increasing climate warming, posing widespread risks on ecosystem, agricultural, and water resources, therefore effective and timely drought monitoring supports drought assessment, management, and mitigation. Coverage: global; published in 2025. Formats: GeoTIFF. The data are held in Science Data Bank and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 249714024 bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
